title: [3.x] Bullet: btAngularLimit::hasLimit() does not work, causes HingeJoint motor to stop every 360° (#18351)

milestone.title: 3.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 3 release.

body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 3.x / all versions with Bullet
Not reproducible in 4.x, due to no Bullet implementation

### System information

Windows 10 - Godot 3.6.1 stable - GLES3 - RX Vega 56 - Bullet Physics Engine

### Issue description

The bug is related to the hinge joint using a motor with the Bullet Physics Engine.
The function `btAngularLimit::hasLimit()` returns `true` even when the angular limit for the hinge joint is disabled. 
When the setting is changed, the function `HingeJointBullet::set_flag(PhysicsServer::HingeJointFlag p_flag, bool p_value)` in the Bullet wrapper class `hinge_joint_bullet.cpp` is called. This then calls `hingeConstraint->setLimit(-Math_PI, Math_PI)` from `btHingeConstraint.h`, where first argument is the low and the second argument is the high value. 

In `btTypedConstraint.h`, there is a class `btAngularLimit` with `btAngularLimit::set`. 
The description states:
```
/// Sets all limit's parameters.
/// When low > high limit becomes inactive.
/// When high - low > 2PI limit is ineffective too because no angle can exceed the limit
void set(btScalar low, btScalar high, btScalar _softness = 0.9f, btScalar _biasFactor = 0.3f, btScalar _relaxationFactor = 1.0f);
```
This function gets called by `setLimit(-Math_PI, Math_PI)` and because PI - (-Pi) is not greater than PI (just equal) the limit is active. If you instead use `setLimit(0, -2)` (so `m_halfRange` gets -1, like the default constructor does), everything works fine and the limit is deactivated as expected.

This incorrect activation causes strange behavior when using a motor with a hinge joint:
The motor stops every 360°, waits briefly, and then start spinning again.
After changing the call from `setLimit(-Math_PI, Math_PI)` to `setLimit(0, -2)`, everything worked as expected.

This bug is also described in  issue https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/18351.
I also created a pull request to fix the issue: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/108752

Video for reference:
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3ad91a77-ccde-44d4-95e3-09eebd519aac

### Steps to reproduce

Just use a hinge joint with a motor and disable all angular limits.
